messages:
marie: Heads-up: planning an online schema change + backfill for users table tomorrow (02:00-04:00 UTC). Goal: add user_shard int and backfill by shard. Need lock plan, rate limits, and rollback wording. pinging db + sre.

sanjay: +1. migration id `20260321_add_user_shard`. It's a light DDL (ADD COLUMN) but the backfill will touch ~120M rows across 8 shards. We'll use chunked updates per shard.

ben: Worker memory profile looks ok but we should throttle writes during the window. Suggest `--max-inflight=4` per worker and 2000 rows/chunk. Also pin app to `v2.14.3` for the window to avoid new client changes.

kira: SRE checks: set circuit breaker to failover to read-only for writes if DB 5xx > 0.5% for 5m, and p95 latency > 800ms. Need runbook link and monitoring dashboards ready. I'll attach runbook in channel. :thumbsup:

marie: Here is the migration SQL and backfill snippet:```sql
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN user_shard INTEGER DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL;
-- backfill (example):
UPDATE users SET user_shard = (id % 8) WHERE user_shard = 0 LIMIT 2000;
```

marie: Backfill runner command (k8s job):```bash
kubectl exec -it job/backfill-users -- /app/backfill --migration=20260321_add_user_shard \
  --shard=3 --batch-size=2000 --max-inflight=4
```

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: `canary->bulk` for service `user-service` with tag `2026-03-21-migration` at 2026-03-21T02:10:00Z. Migrations: `20260321_add_user_shard`. Canary 5% for 15m then 100% if green.

marie: Canary plan: run migration on shard 0 only for canary. Verify metrics for 30m: error rate, p95, DB locks. If no regressions, roll through remaining shards with stagger (shard 1-7 every 15m).

sanjay: Locking: ADD COLUMN is lock-free on our Postgres version, but we should still coordinate maintenance locks for backfill to avoid hotspotting. We'll run backfills with lower txn size and use advisory locks per-shard: `pg_try_advisory_lock(hashtext('users_shard_3'))` to avoid overlap.

ben: If we hit >0.5% 5xx in canary, abort rollout and run rollback: 1) stop backfill jobs 2) revert app pin (roll back to previous tag) 3) run compaction on partial updates to ensure consistency.

kira: I'll create an incident channel if thresholds are breached and will run the rollback playbook. Also pre-authorize a quick capacity increase if DB CPU creeps up >70%.

marie: Release notes snippet for on-call and customers: "Added user_shard column to users to enable partition-aware reads/writes. Rolling back is safe; migration is additive. Performance impact expected to be minimal; monitoring in place."

oncall-bot: @oncall reminder: scheduled change window: 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC. Pager rotation active.

ben: small nit: tag the migration in the deploy manifest: `migrations: [20260321_add_user_shard]` and pin docker digest for canary.

marie: Acks? please react with :white_check_mark: when you own a task (DB backfill config, deploy manifest, SRE runbook, monitoring dashboards). I'll collect before EOD.

sanjay: I'll own backfill config. :white_check_mark:

kira: I'll own runbook + monitors. :white_check_mark:

ben: I'll update deploy manifest and tag pin. :white_check_mark:

marie: thanks. Will post final checklist once all artifacts are attached.
